decision: Do not promote the80epoch models. Both treatment seeds retain every formerly correct background row but lose the same formerly accepted blue crop. Neither learns all seven new probes.
interpretation: The new penalty addresses the observed background forgetting, but trades against a blue positive and reduces correction of other background errors. Fewer regressions alone does not establish a better detector. All counts refer to correlated TRAIN crop views.
next_experiment: Separately freeze a400epoch paired convergence trial, resetting all runs to the same parent and stretching the same cosine schedule to52800steps. Keep images, masks, weights, architecture,0.8 inference threshold and acceptance gate unchanged. Final epoch only, no checkpoint or development-based selection. This tests whether additional fitting resolves the remaining underfit examples, not a promised accuracy gain.
